Sandbox_DynamicObjectives.QuestDifficult: Global multiplier for encounter-based objective spawns. Higher values spawn more quest zombies and raise the required kill count.
Sandbox_DynamicObjectives.QuestExpiratio: Scales the base expiration for generated Dynamic Objectives quests. Set to 0 to disable quest expiration.
Sandbox_DynamicObjectives.RestingContrac: After the minimum resting quest family floor is satisfied, each remaining resting contract family gets this percent chance to appear as another available job.
Sandbox_DynamicObjectives.MinimumResting: Guarantees up to this many resting quest families are available when eligible traders exist. Missing families are filled before optional extras are rolled.
Sandbox_DynamicObjectives.EscortIncident: After the minimum escort incident floor is satisfied, this percent chance adds one extra pending escort incident when eligible traders exist.
Sandbox_DynamicObjectives.MinimumEscortI: Guarantees at least this many pending escort incidents when eligible traders and rescue sites exist. If the floor cannot be met, debug logs explain why.
Sandbox_DynamicObjectives.QuestRewardPoo: Allows Dynamic Objectives procedural quest rewards to include weapon items from the Dynamic Trading item registry.
Allows Dynamic Objectives procedural quest rewards to include medicine and medical-tool items from the Dynamic Trading item registry.
Allows Dynamic Objectives procedural quest rewards to include food and drink items from the Dynamic Trading item registry.
Allows Dynamic Objectives procedural quest rewards to include bag and backpack items from the Dynamic Trading item registry.
Sandbox_DynamicObjectives.QuestRewardMin: Minimum cash paid directly to the player when a Dynamic Objectives quest includes a money reward. Set to 0 to disable the floor.
